method.rule: Reject crop/number/option swaps, generic disclaimers and propositions already represented in distractors. Eligible means potential independence from weekly assessments only; no global uniqueness, source certification or mock readiness.

objectives.objectiveJa: 元肥・追肥、直接接触と過剰施肥の障害を区別する。
objectives.reason: Timing and salts already assessed; direct-root-contact warning also appears in q09 distractor. No new count.

objectives.objectiveJa: 成分の表示順序、袋重量と百分率、高度化成の境界を区別する。
objectives.reason: Same calculation and classification mechanism; changing component, bag size or examples is not independent.

objectives.objectiveJa: 肥料量の比例計算を逆算し、対象面積を保つ。
objectives.reason: Inverse check is the same assessed proportion, not extra objective.

objectives.objectiveJa: 一成分で求めた肥料量では、他成分の過不足まで解決したとは判断できない。
objectives.reason: Multi-component information sufficiency differs from single-component calculation; do not invent required nutrient amounts.

objectives.objectiveJa: 明きょとうねの機能、作る時期と高うねの条件を区別する。
objectives.reason: Existing function/conditions; tool substitutions add no independent objective.

objectives.objectiveJa: うね幅・うね高・うね間・ベッド幅を位置で区別する。
objectives.reason: Potential visual objective, but requires exact source-definition/figure verification; not counted here.

objectives.objectiveJa: 埋設排水管と、硬盤・心土へ亀裂を入れる施工を構造で区別する。
objectives.reason: q15 only mentions buried drain as a wrong surface-ditch definition; does not compare buried pipe with subsoiling.

objectives.objectiveJa: 排水方法の作業性・施工負担・改善範囲を別の比較軸として扱う。
objectives.reason: Tradeoffs and local extent differ from naming drainage methods; one combined candidate.

objectives.objectiveJa: 摘心・わき芽かき・摘葉を取り除く位置で分ける。
objectives.reason: Existing organ-position distinction.

objectives.objectiveJa: 混み合った葉やわき芽の調整を日当たり・通風と管理のしやすさへ結び付ける。
objectives.reason: Canopy-management causal purpose differs from naming parts; one combined objective.

objectives.objectiveJa: 摘蕾・摘花・摘果の段階と残す果実への配分を区別する。
objectives.reason: Core stage/purpose and later staged thinning already assessed.

objectives.objectiveJa: 摘果の対象を個数だけでなく、記録された被害や形の異常にも照らす。
objectives.reason: State-based selection differs from count redistribution; supply observed state rather than requiring pathogen diagnosis.

objectives.objectiveJa: 受粉部位、人手・昆虫利用と結実結果を整理する。
objectives.reason: q06 explicitly rejects guaranteed set; compatibility assessed elsewhere. Crop examples/disclaimer rewrites are not new.

objectives.objectiveJa: 整枝・誘引の枝配置と八の字固定を整理する。
objectives.reason: Positioning, tree forms and tying assessed; no count for crop substitution.

objectives.objectiveJa: 収穫適期の目安と予冷の目的・方式を分ける。
objectives.reason: Existing maturity/cooling/cold-chain assessment.

objectives.objectiveJa: 朝早い収穫を収穫物の熱とその後の冷却に結び付けて説明する。
objectives.reason: Harvest-time heat relation differs from naming precooling purpose; no fixed temperature/time.

objectives.objectiveJa: トンネルとべたがけを支柱と覆う位置で区別する。
objectives.reason: Directly assessed structural contrast.

objectives.objectiveJa: べたがけの発芽安定・初期生育への働きを目的として説明する。
objectives.reason: Establishment function differs from supported/contact geometry; no blanket weather/pest guarantee.

objectives.objectiveJa: マルチの色、反射、穴の有無を働きと対応させる。
objectives.reason: Color/infiltration already assessed, white also in distractor; no per-color inflation.

objectives.objectiveJa: 生分解性から処理場所の許可を推定しない。
objectives.reason: Current disposal rules held; generic caution is not fresh agronomic objective.

objectives.objectiveJa: 予防・早期発見、天敵・資材と薬剤の対象を区別する。
objectives.reason: q13 distractor already conflates fungicide/insecticide; other mechanisms already tested.

objectives.objectiveJa: 種子を増やさず、遮光・中耕・培土・耕うんの条件を区別する。
objectives.reason: q16 distractors include seed introduction and shading; q14 location, machinery assessed elsewhere.

objectives.objectiveJa: IPMで複数手段を組み合わせ、化学農薬低減と経済的損失低減を両立して考える。
objectives.reason: Economic purpose and integration differ from general prevention and isolated mechanism questions; one candidate.

objectives.objectiveJa: 耕種的・物理的・生物的・化学的な手段を分類する。
objectives.reason: Most examples tested. Pheromone mechanism requires cross-range audit before counting; reclassification alone is not new.

objectives.objectiveJa: 機種に合う始動・停止・ブレーキと疲労・飲酒の回避を整理する。
objectives.reason: Existing questions include external appearance/model distractors.

objectives.objectiveJa: 衣服の巻込みと農薬接触は危険が異なり、農薬用保護具を回転機械へ一律に流用しない。
objectives.reason: Task-specific hazard transfer differs from pesticide mask timing; no recommendation for a particular machine.

objectives.objectiveJa: 点検目的と詰まり除去時の停止・個別確認を分ける。
objectives.reason: Existing inspection/clogging objective.

objectives.objectiveJa: 前・中・後の点検を分け、動作点検の例外を中断や詰まり除去へ広げない。
objectives.reason: Temporal categories/interruption not directly tested by clogging-only question; one conditional distinction.

objectives.objectiveJa: 農薬保護具の部位・準備時期・袖裾の重なりを確認する。
objectives.reason: Already assessed coverage and timing; no count per body part.

objectives.objectiveJa: 薬液で濡れる軍手を農薬作業用とせず、手袋名だけで全薬剤適合を保証しない。
objectives.reason: Specific absorption limitation differs from mask timing/sleeve overlap.

objectives.objectiveJa: 使用前の製品条件確認と使用簿記録を区別する。
objectives.reason: Existing product/record questions.

objectives.objectiveJa: 農薬の鍵付き専用保管を、使用記録とは別の管理事項として確認する。
objectives.reason: Secure storage differs from label reading and recordkeeping; source principle only.

objectives.objectiveJa: 噴霧器接続部点検と飛散・強風中止を区別する。
objectives.reason: Already assessed.

objectives.objectiveJa: 散布天候判断で、強風だけでなく雨と降雨直前直後も確認する。
objectives.reason: Rain timing is physically distinct from wind drift; no invented waiting interval.

objectives.objectiveJa: 洗浄・手洗いと残液・洗浄水の処分を分ける。
objectives.reason: Specific disposal held; generic disclaimer cannot be counted as a procedure.

objectives.objectiveJa: 散布中・後のめまいや吐き気では継続せず、速やかに医師の診察を受ける。
objectives.reason: Symptom-triggered stopping/consultation differs from routine fatigue; no diagnosis or self-treatment.

objectives.objectiveJa: 電源・燃料適合と濡れた手・給油時停止・火気の危険を分ける。
objectives.reason: Electrical category, unknown/aged fuel assessed; voltage/fuel substitutions add no independent decision.

objectives.objectiveJa: 工具をボルト外側・六角穴・ねじ溝に接する構造で対応させる。
objectives.reason: Hex and screwdriver interfaces explicit in existing distractors; name swaps not independent. Original visual recognition still open.

objectives.objectiveJa: 脚立の損傷・設置・開き止め・天板・横への乗出しを確認する。
objectives.reason: Damage also in distractors; core safety distinctions already represented.

objectives.objectiveJa: 持続する前屈や細かい作業を計画に記録し、姿勢変化・目を休める区切りを設ける。
objectives.reason: Ergonomic exposure differs from fatigue/drinking/ladder checks; one workload objective.

objectives.objectiveJa: 清掃・洗浄後の乾燥・整備・収納・記録を運転後の作業計画に含める。
objectives.reason: End-job sequence differs from generic tool care, but cross-range dedup still required.

objectives.objectiveJa: 希釈倍数と使用量・使用液量を分け、倍率だけでは散布量を確定できないと読む。
objectives.reason: Existing arbitrary-increase prohibition does not assess field meanings; no actual dilution prescription.

objectives.objectiveJa: 本剤回数と同じ有効成分の総回数を区別し、商品名変更で成分回数を無関係にしない。
objectives.reason: Different label-accounting objective rather than product substitution.

objectives.objectiveJa: 最終有効期限とロット番号を、使用可能時期と追跡情報に分ける。
objectives.reason: Validity versus traceability unassessed; no live product ruling.

objectives.objectiveJa: 胚・胚乳・もみがらを位置と役割で区別する。
objectives.reason: Already directly assessed.

objectives.objectiveJa: 種子消毒の目的と対象を理解し、線虫と病原菌をひとまとめにしない。
objectives.reason: Disinfection purpose tested; taxonomy detail not promoted while unresolved.

objectives.objectiveJa: 浸種・催芽の目的とハト胸の状態を区別する。
objectives.reason: Existing purposes/state including overlong-sprout distractor.

objectives.objectiveJa: 浸種の水温・日数と播種前催芽の加温条件を、段階名と条件の組で読む。
objectives.reason: Stage-specific conditional reading distinct from purpose-only q03; one combined objective, not counts per number.

objectives.objectiveJa: 育苗箱の準備順序と催芽・出芽の前後関係を分ける。
objectives.reason: Existing preparation/pre-post sowing questions.

objectives.objectiveJa: 出芽後の緑化までの被覆管理と、温度・苗状態を伴う稚苗・中苗の日数例を区別する。
objectives.reason: After-emergence management differs from box preparation; one staged candidate pending rice-stage cross-range dedup.

limits: No fresh PDF verification or source-hold resolution.
Numeric source examples are not operational prescriptions.
Cross-range dedup and exact source/hold verification required before authoring.
Several paragraphs can support one objective; neither paragraph nor level counts multiply the objective count.
Conservative overlap includes distractors, not only linked knowledge IDs.
